about.heading: About
about.p1: Seishin is a company created to solve difficulties and facilitate administration and human resources tasks in foreign-capital companies.
about.p2: We provide outsourcing, recruitment, consulting, legal procedures, legal translations and emerging technology solutions.
about.founder_bio: A leader committed to industrial development in Mexico. He founded Seishin with the mission of connecting talent, leading successful labor placement processes with foreign-capital companies seeking efficiency and commitment.
